name: teamtailor-mcp
description: Teamtailor (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_teamtailor_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMTAILOR_API_KEY
platform_mcp_teamtailor_api_key.description: Teamtailor API key with the Public scope (read), created at https://app.teamtailor.com/app/settings/integrations/api-keys; sent as `Authorization: Token token=<key>`.

platform_mcp_teamtailor_api_host.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMTAILOR_API_HOST
platform_mcp_teamtailor_api_host.description: Teamtailor API host for the account's data stack: api.teamtailor.com (EU stack) or api.na.teamtailor.com (NA stack).

tools.name: me
tools.description: Verified with a one-job list, which a Public-scope key can read ('Can read all public data, for example, jobs, departments, and locations').

tools.name: search
tools.description: JSON:API list of the key owner's OWN published public jobs (GET /v1/jobs, filter[status]=published, filter[feed]=public), not a cross-company search. Filters take division/department/role/location ids and tags only, so query/location are not sent — filter client-side. Paging: page[number] and page[size] ('Default: 10, max: 30'); total = meta.record-count. Requests carry the required 'X-Api-Version' header (20240904). created-at 'Requires admin permission' and is null for a Public key; locations/department are relations (not included), and pitch, remote-status, employment-type, salary-time-unit, end-date and links.careersite-job-apply-url are in raw. Rate limit: '50 requests every 10 seconds' (429).

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /v1/jobs/{id} 'Retreive a specific job' as a JSON:API document {data: {id, attributes, links, relationships}}.
